create_EditDataset: create an EditDataset instance to load and process a named editing dataset from raw or cached data
call_get_features: call get_features on EditDataset to extract specific columns like edits or raw from train dev or test splits
call_get_edits: call get_edits on EditDataset to retrieve reference edits for given ids across specified splits
call_get_inputs: call get_inputs on EditDataset to fetch input fields including title input edits tasks and retrieved documents
call_evaluate: call evaluate on EditDataset to score predictions against reference edits using the Evaluator with optional metric report
